``` {.python .cell-code}
    "out_network_links": Path("_data/raw/WFv1000_MasterNet - Link.gpkg"),
    "out_network_nodes": Path("_data/raw/WFv1000_MasterNet - Node.gpkg"),
```

## Download and Store Data

### Roadway Centerlines

::: {#9c673c47 .cell execution_count=5}
``` {.python .cell-code}
out_path = config_filepath["out_centerlines"]

if not out_path.exists():
    gdf_centerlines = fetch_feature_layer(
        service_url="https://services1.arcgis.com/99lidPhWCzftIe9K/ArcGIS/rest/services/UtahRoads/FeatureServer/0",
        gis=gis_anon,
    )
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    gdf_centerlines.to_crs(CRS_UTM).to_file(out_path, driver="GPKG")
    print(f"Saved to: {out_path}")
else:
    print(f"File already exists, skipping download: {out_path}")
```

## Centerline Cleaning

Converts raw UGRC centerlines into a topology-clean `CandidateTDMRoadLinks`
dataset that the snapping and true-shape pipeline consumes.  The algorithm
(dissolve → split at junctions → attribute transfer) lives in
`_src/centerline_utils.py`; only the filter definitions belong here.

### Load and Filter Raw Centerlines

::: {#de3c84be .cell execution_count=9}
``` {.python .cell-code}
gdf_cl = gpd.read_file(
    config_filepath["out_centerlines"],
    where="DOT_RTNAME NOT IN ('DupRoute', 'Dupe') AND STATUS NOT IN ('Retired', 'Planned')",
)

# The raw UGRC export contains literal duplicate rows (identical OBJECTID,
# attributes, and geometry) for a large share of features -- not route
# concurrency, just duplicated source records. Left in place, every
# duplicated endpoint is double-counted by build_junction_split_points'
# vertex self-join, spuriously inflating Join_Count at ordinary 2-way
# pass-through points and forcing unwanted splits. Keep one copy per OBJECTID.
gdf_cl = gdf_cl.drop_duplicates(subset=["OBJECTID"]).copy()

# ── Wasatch Front county FIPS codes ───────────────────────────────────────
WF_COUNTIES = {"49003", "49011", "49035", "49049", "49057", "49045"}

mask_wf = gdf_cl["COUNTY_L"].isin(WF_COUNTIES) | gdf_cl["COUNTY_R"].isin(WF_COUNTIES)
gdf_wf = gdf_cl[mask_wf].copy()

# Strip leading/trailing whitespace in DOT_FCLASS (known data-quality artifact)
gdf_wf["DOT_FCLASS"] = gdf_wf["DOT_FCLASS"].str.strip()

print(f"WF centerlines: {len(gdf_wf):,} rows")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
WF centerlines: 168,306 rows
```
:::
:::


### Define Freeway and Surface Filters

::: {#b1ca96cc .cell execution_count=10}
``` {.python .cell-code}
# ── Freeway / ramp / CD filter ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Matches arcpy: DOT_FCLASS IN ('Interstate','Other Freeway')
#                OR DOT_RTNAME LIKE '%C%'  (collector-distributor roads)
#                OR DOT_RTNAME LIKE '%R%'  (ramp roads)
FWY_FCLASS = {"Interstate", "Other Freeway"}
mask_fwy = (
    gdf_wf["DOT_FCLASS"].isin(FWY_FCLASS)
    | gdf_wf["DOT_RTNAME"].str.contains("C", na=False)
    | gdf_wf["DOT_RTNAME"].str.contains("R", na=False)
)

# ── Surface street filter ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
SURF_FCLASS = {
    "Local",
    "Major Collector",
    "Minor Arterial",
    "Minor Collector",
    "Principal Arterial",
}
mask_surf = gdf_wf["DOT_FCLASS"].isin(SURF_FCLASS)

# ── Per-vert-level splits ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VERT_LEVEL '0' = at-grade (default); '1','2','3' = elevated/tunnel structures.
# rcl_merge silently skips any level whose GeoDataFrame is empty.
fwy_levels = {
    "all":  gdf_wf[mask_fwy],
    "lvl0": gdf_wf[mask_fwy & (gdf_wf["VERT_LEVEL"] == "0")],
    "lvl1": gdf_wf[mask_fwy & (gdf_wf["VERT_LEVEL"] == "1")],
    "lvl2": gdf_wf[mask_fwy & (gdf_wf["VERT_LEVEL"] == "2")],
    "lvl3": gdf_wf[mask_fwy & (gdf_wf["VERT_LEVEL"] == "3")],
}

surf_levels = {
    "lvl0": gdf_wf[mask_surf & (gdf_wf["VERT_LEVEL"] == "0")],
    "lvl1": gdf_wf[mask_surf & (gdf_wf["VERT_LEVEL"] == "1")],
    "lvl2": gdf_wf[mask_surf & (gdf_wf["VERT_LEVEL"] == "2")],
    "lvl3": gdf_wf[mask_surf & (gdf_wf["VERT_LEVEL"] == "3")],
}

for k, v in fwy_levels.items():
    print(f"  fwy {k}: {len(v):,}")
for k, v in surf_levels.items():
    print(f"  surf {k}: {len(v):,}")
```

```
  fwy lvl1: 595
  fwy lvl2: 21
  fwy lvl3: 5

  surf lvl1: 182
  surf lvl2: 9
  surf lvl3: 1
```

:::


### Run RCL Merge

::: {#cecc500c .cell execution_count=11}
``` {.python .cell-code}
out_path = config_filepath["out_candidate_links"]

if not out_path.exists():
    gdf_candidate = rcl_merge(fwy_levels, surf_levels)
    print(f"Candidate links (geometry only): {len(gdf_candidate):,} rows")

    # ── Transfer attributes from original centerlines via midpoint join ────
    # OBJECTID is the persistent physical ID required for GERS lineage.
    # DOT_FCLASS, POSTTYPE, DOT_RTNAME, FULLNAME drive direction inference
    # in the snapping pipeline.
    TRANSFER_COLS = [
        "OBJECTID",
        "UNIQUE_ID",
        "DOT_FCLASS",
        "POSTTYPE",
        "DOT_RTNAME",
        "DOT_HWYNAM",
        "FULLNAME",
        "CARTOCODE",
        "ONEWAY",
        "VERT_LEVEL",
        "SPEED_LMT",
    ]
    gdf_candidate = transfer_attributes_by_midpoint(
        gdf_candidate, gdf_wf, TRANSFER_COLS
    )

    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    gdf_candidate.to_file(out_path, driver="GPKG")
    print(f"Saved to: {out_path}")
else:
    print(f"File already exists, skipping: {out_path}")
```
